relations: The anchored soap film steadily grows in area, elongating into a long ribbon-like tail.
The person walks backward, shifting the wand leftward and slightly upward to pull the film's near end.
The film's upper portion rises and enlarges, stretching toward the tree branches without detaching or popping.
The background remains fixed as the expanding soap film dominates the foreground motion.
caption: The video captures a person standing on a quiet residential street, holding two sticks whose string loop forms a giant bubble wand. A silver sedan, a single-story house, a large tree, and trimmed hedges fill the background, while a small bottle rests on the ground nearby. An iridescent soap film, already anchored to the wand loop at the first frame, stretches out toward the tree trunk while the person's arms remain raised in a wide V-hold. As the sequence unfolds, the soap film steadily grows in area and elongates into a long ribbon-like tail. Its far, upper portion rises and enlarges, transforming from a compact blob into a tall, bulbous sheet that reaches up toward the tree branches. The near end stays attached to the wand loop, which shifts leftward and slightly upward as the person walks backward toward the left edge of the frame, while the stationary camera holds the background fixed. The film continues stretching upward as the clip ends mid-expansion, without detaching or popping in view.
